basic_info.description: Don't miss this beautifully updated Miraloma home in a great location and with partial ocean views. This home has a classic Miraloma floor plan that has been tastefully updated for modern living. The gourmet kitchen offers high end appliances, and ample counter and storage space. The kitchen island opens up to the formal dining room, making entertaining easy. The formal living room has partial ocean views, recessed lighting, and a decorative fireplace. One bedroom and a full bath complete this level.      The primary bedroom has been re-imagined with the addition of an en suite bathroom and overlooks the beautiful back yard. A third bedroom, currently staged as an office, opens to the back deck and lush garden.    Downstairs is a large garage with laundry and an EV charger with plenty of room for parking,  storage and a workspace.      Conveniently located near Mollie Stones shopping center, West Portal shops and restaurants, freeways and Forest Hill station.
